title: Set Total P&L display span to static value 17.5

requirements.text: Update the selected element at XPath /html[1]/body[1]/div[1]/div[1]/main[1]/div[1]/section[2]/div[1]/div[1]/div[2]/div[1]/span[1] (the Total P&L value span on the Home page) so that it displays exactly the static text "17.5" with no added formatting (e.g., no "$" prefix, no toFixed, no fallback values), while keeping the element as a <span> and not changing any other elements.
acceptanceCriteria: When navigating to the Home page, the Total P&L card’s value span renders exactly: 17.5
The displayed value is not derived from metrics, does not use numeric formatting (e.g., toFixed), and does not include a currency symbol
Only the selected span element is modified; surrounding layout/structure and other metric cards remain unchanged

constraints: Apply changes ONLY to the selected element identified by XPath: /html[1]/body[1]/div[1]/div[1]/main[1]/div[1]/section[2]/div[1]/div[1]/div[2]/div[1]/span[1].
Do not edit any files under frontend/src/components/ui (read-only).
Do not modify frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.ts, frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.tsx, frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts, or frontend/src/main.tsx (immutable paths).
Use English for any user-facing text.
nonGoals: Do not make Total P&L dynamically calculated from trades/metrics.
Do not add UI controls to edit Total P&L.
Do not change backend metrics/trade calculations or persistence.
